2027 Walt Disney World Military Salute tickets are here! And for eligible military families planning a Disney vacation next year, there are some exciting ways to save on both theme park tickets and Disney Resort hotel stays.

Disney has announced its 2027 military offers, including a special ticket that allows repeat visits throughout much of the year, traditional 4-, 5-, and 6-day tickets, and resort room discounts of up to 30%.

But before you start planning, there are a few important details worth understanding. Not every veteran qualifies, some dates are excluded, and the new repeat-visit ticket works differently from an Annual Pass.

Let’s walk through the offers so you can see what might work best for your family’s Disney plans!

🎟️ 2027 Disney Military Salute Ticket Prices

Disney is offering four promotional ticket options for eligible U.S. military members and their families.

Ticket OptionPark HopperPark Hopper Plus
Disney Celebrates America Military Salute$549$579
6-Day Military Salute$469$499
5-Day Military Salute$449$479
4-Day Military Salute$429$459

These are Disney’s advertised prices before tax. Tickets purchased through participating military base ticket offices or Shades of Green are tax-free, and individual military ticket offices may offer lower prices.

What’s the difference between Park Hopper and Park Hopper Plus?

Park Hopper allows you to visit more than one Walt Disney World theme park on the same day.

Park Hopper Plus adds a certain number of visits to eligible water parks and other recreational experiences, depending on the ticket purchased.

For families who enjoy spending time at the water parks, Park Hopper Plus may be worth considering. Just remember that water park availability can vary with the season, weather, and scheduled closures.

✨ Disney Celebrates America: A Different Kind of Military Ticket

One of the most interesting options for 2027 is the Disney Celebrates America Military Salute Ticket.

Instead of limiting guests to four, five, or six theme park days, this ticket allows eligible guests to return for additional park visits throughout its valid admission period, subject to park reservations, blockout dates, and availability.

The price starts at $549 with Park Hopper or $579 with Park Hopper Plus.

That could be especially appealing for military families who live near Walt Disney World or plan to make several visits during 2027.

But here’s something important:

This is not a Walt Disney World Annual Pass.

The Celebrates America ticket does not include Annual Passholder benefits such as complimentary theme park parking, merchandise discounts, or dining discounts.

Guests using this ticket may hold up to five park reservations at a time on a rolling basis.

So while the opportunity for repeat visits sounds wonderful, families should compare the full benefits and limitations before deciding whether this ticket is the right fit.

📅 Important 2027 Ticket Dates and Blockout Dates

The 2027 Military Salute tickets are valid for admission from January 1 through December 21, 2027.

However, all ticket types have two blockout periods:

  • March 21–April 3, 2027
  • November 21–27, 2027

Tickets cannot be used during these dates, and all tickets expire after December 21, 2027.

Theme park reservations are required.

Unlike some standard date-based Disney tickets, Military Salute tickets require both valid admission and a theme park reservation for the park you’re planning to visit.

If you’re purchasing Park Hopper tickets, you’ll need a reservation for your first park and must enter that park before hopping to another.

Disney recommends checking reservation availability before buying tickets and making your reservations as soon as possible after purchase.

For families planning around school breaks, holidays, or military leave, checking these dates early is especially important.

🇺🇸 Does Being a Veteran Qualify You for Disney’s Military Discounts?

This is one of the most important details in the entire announcement.

Being a military veteran does not automatically mean someone qualifies for Disney’s Military Salute offers.

Disney defines eligible service members as active-duty or retired members of the U.S. military, including qualifying National Guard and Reserve members, Coast Guard, Space Force, and the commissioned corps of the Public Health Service and NOAA.

Eligible military spouses may also qualify when they have the required valid military identification.

But what about someone who served honorably and later separated from the military without retiring?

Under Disney’s published Military Salute eligibility rules, prior service alone does not establish eligibility for these particular offers.

That distinction matters because the words veteran and military retiree aren’t interchangeable when it comes to Disney’s promotional ticket rules.

If you’re unsure whether your military status qualifies, check with a participating military ticket office before purchasing tickets or making vacation plans around the discount.

🎫 How Many Military Salute Tickets Can You Purchase?

Disney generally allows an eligible service member or their spouse to purchase up to six promotional tickets total under the 2027 offer.

Normally, one of those six tickets must be used by the eligible service member or their spouse.

There is one especially helpful exception for qualifying Annual Passholders.

If the eligible service member or spouse already has a valid Walt Disney World Annual Pass at the time of purchase and when a promotional ticket is used, they may purchase up to five Military Salute tickets without purchasing one for themselves.

This can be helpful for military families who already visit Disney regularly but want to bring eligible family members or friends along.

Each promotional ticket must be used by the same person throughout its use. Tickets cannot be transferred or resold.

🏰 Already Have Disney Annual Passes? Here’s What to Know

If you’ve already purchased or renewed Walt Disney World Annual Passes, you might wonder whether these military offers could save you money.

The first question is still eligibility. Having an Annual Pass doesn’t make someone eligible for Military Salute tickets unless they meet Disney’s military requirements.

Disney also doesn’t advertise a retroactive Military Salute discount or conversion for Annual Passes you’ve already purchased.

However, eligible military Annual Passholders may still benefit from the promotional ticket rules when purchasing tickets for family members or friends.

And if you’re considering switching from an Annual Pass to the Celebrates America ticket in a future year, compare more than the admission price.

Annual Passes may include parking and eligible dining or merchandise discounts that aren’t included with the military promotional ticket.

For frequent visitors, those extra benefits can make a meaningful difference.

🏨 2027 Disney Military Resort Discounts: Save Up to 30%

The ticket announcement isn’t the only good news!

Disney is also offering eligible U.S. military members room discounts of up to 30% at select Disney Resorts Collection hotels for qualifying nights in 2027.

The offer applies to select stays from January 1 through December 21, 2027, with bookings required by December 21, 2027.

The actual savings depend on the resort, room type, and travel dates.

Deluxe Resorts and Select Villas — Save Up to 30%

At participating Deluxe Resorts and select villa accommodations, eligible guests can save:

  • 30% for most nights June 1–August 31, 2027.
  • 25% for most eligible nights January 1–March 20, April 4–May 31, September 1–November 20, and November 28–December 21, 2027.

Participating accommodations include select rooms at Disney’s Animal Kingdom Lodge, Contemporary Resort, Grand Floridian Resort & Spa, Polynesian Village Resort, Wilderness Lodge, Yacht Club Resort, Beach Club Resort, BoardWalk Inn, and several Disney Vacation Club villa resorts.

Disney’s Lakeshore Lodge is also listed for eligible stays beginning July 1, 2027.

Moderate Resorts — Save Up to 25%

Participating Moderate Resort accommodations offer:

  • 25% for most nights June 1–August 31, 2027.
  • 20% during the other eligible offer periods.

These include Disney’s Caribbean Beach Resort, Coronado Springs Resort, Port Orleans Resort – French Quarter, and Port Orleans Resort – Riverside.

Art of Animation family suites are included in this discount group as well.

Value Resorts — Save Up to 20%

Families looking for a more budget-friendly Disney Resort stay may be interested in:

  • 20% for most nights June 1–August 31, 2027.
  • 15% during the other eligible offer periods.

Participating options include Disney’s All-Star Movies, All-Star Music, All-Star Sports, Pop Century, Art of Animation standard rooms, and the campsites at Fort Wilderness.

A little planning tip: The biggest percentage discount doesn’t always mean the lowest total vacation cost. Compare the actual room price after the discount, not just the percentage advertised.

📞 How to Book the 2027 Military Resort Offer

Disney directs eligible guests to call (407) 939-7830 to check availability and book a room with the military resort discount.

A valid military ID is required at check-in, and the eligible military member or qualifying spouse must stay in the room.

A few other details to keep in mind:

  • Discounted rooms are limited and may not be available for every date or room category.
  • Certain room types are excluded.
  • Length-of-stay requirements may apply.
  • The offer cannot be combined with other promotions.
  • Theme park admission is not included with the room-only discount.

If you already have a resort reservation, it’s worth asking Disney whether an eligible offer can be applied to your stay. Any change depends on the reservation terms and availability.

📸 Military Memory Maker Offer for 2027

Here’s another savings opportunity families may appreciate!

Eligible service members or their spouses can purchase Memory Maker for $98 through December 21, 2027.

Memory Maker allows guests to download eligible Disney PhotoPass photos captured during the applicable Memory Maker window.

That can include family photos in front of Cinderella Castle, character photos, and participating attraction photos.

There are a few restrictions:

  • The special-price Memory Maker must be purchased at a Walt Disney World theme park ticket window.
  • Eligible service members or spouses may purchase up to two.
  • The standard Memory Maker photo window is generally 30 days from first activation.
  • Valid admission and park reservations are required for certain photo locations.

For families who love having everyone in the picture together, it’s an option worth including in the vacation budget.

🛍️ Where to Buy 2027 Disney Military Salute Tickets

Disney lists several purchasing options:

  • Participating U.S. military base ticket offices.
  • Shades of Green at Walt Disney World.
  • Walt Disney World theme park ticket windows.

Tickets purchased at participating military base offices or Shades of Green are tax-free. Tickets purchased at Disney theme park ticket windows have tax added.

Eligible service members or their spouses must present valid military identification.

And remember: Tickets must be activated at a Walt Disney World theme park ticket window by the eligible service member or spouse before use.

If you’re purchasing tickets for relatives or friends, make sure everyone understands the activation requirement before arriving for their park day.

❤️ A Little Disney Planning Magic for Military Families

For eligible military families, these 2027 offers create some wonderful opportunities to enjoy Walt Disney World while keeping vacation costs in mind.

The Celebrates America ticket may appeal to families planning repeat visits, while the traditional 4-, 5-, and 6-day tickets may be a better fit for a single vacation.

Resort savings can make an on-property stay more affordable, and the special Memory Maker price offers another way to bring home those family memories.

The biggest thing I want families to remember is to verify eligibility, compare the complete cost, and check your dates before purchasing.

Disney vacations are a big investment, and understanding the details ahead of time helps you spend more of your trip enjoying the magic instead of worrying about surprises.
